verdict.rationale: Ollama is a model runtime and API server, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. Its agent connections run through REST, OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible APIs and the 'ollama launch' command. These are adjacent integrations, not an official MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
